detail: Audit and repair measurable accuracy/glitch problems in the generated catalogue, then author a synchronized battle-shonen sword-vs-fist exchange: rapid engagement, attacks from both fighters, blocks, perfect counters, hit reactions, impact holds, and clean recoveries. Add presentation and timing polish without changing unrelated game files.
done_when: Paired 60 fps tracks and a frame/contact manifest exist; every attack, block, counter and hit has matching contact timing; automated quality checks show no critical stretch, pop, hyperextension, floor, or foot-slide issues; front and side contact sheets make every beat readable.
title: Polish animation accuracy and build sword-vs-fist shonen duel
result: codex/shonen-choreography: assets/anim/shonen_duel.glb contains seven original 60 fps tracks (2 synchronized 2.6 s duel tracks, 4 compact gameplay attacks/counters, and a self-authored bow shot replacing Rokoko). Runtime bank no longer loads Rokoko or CMU; shipped movesets reference only UAL, Sekiro, Kevin, and self-authored libraries. docs/anim/shonen_duel/ has paired proof renders and contacts.json; docs/anim/shonen_bow/ has bow key proofs. New/generated clips report 0 quality issues; 23 quality tests pass. Berserk pixel aura now uses 22% authored alpha plus a hot sprite-contour rim. Rust build could not run because this machine has no installed rustup toolchain.
